goals: Answer 11 clarifying questions to establish requirements baseline
Document responses in structured specification format
Produce actionable requirements for subsequent implementation sprint

tasks.title: Gather product goal answers (Q1-Q4): purpose, target users, core value proposition, success metrics
Gather technical constraint answers (Q5-Q7): platform requirements, integration needs, scalability expectations
Gather UX and timeline answers (Q8-Q11): interface preferences, timeline constraints, budget considerations, deployment environment
Consolidate all 11 answers into MasterSpecification with clear requirement statements

acceptanceCriteria.statement: All 11 questions have been answered and documented in the specification
Each question's answer is traceable to a specific requirement ID
Specification includes unambiguous product goals and success criteria
Technical constraints are explicitly stated and non-contradictory
MasterSpecification artifact is complete, valid JSON conforming to schema
